harness_resolutions.original_predicate: Shape-attached rock COM velocity equals body-definition origin velocity [0,0,600]
harness_resolutions.resolution: Incorrect coordinate-point expectation. Box3D body.c:899–906 moves the mass centre after attaching the off-centre rock hull and adds angularVelocity cross (newCenter-oldCenter) to COM velocity. Actual velocities are identical to real CPU after every launch/restart on all routes. Original false assertions retained, no rerun. COM coordinates were not separately captured, so this is source-supported explanation and CPU comparison, not independent numerical mass-centre qualification.

limitations: Paused UI/lifecycle review; no CCD, sensor-event, Stall performance or solver qualification.
Bullet checkbox intentionally applies to next launch only; actual current and newly created body flags were checked.
L actual press creates a replacement; release does not create another. SensorHits B is polled per UI frame and stops after release.
Rock COM velocity predicate corrected by explanation, original receipts preserved; COM coordinates not separately observed.
Review images are not repaired before/after; no product code fixed.
